text: 据柳州市全力做好向海图强、开放发展“123”文章，推动高质量发展新闻发布会消息，2025年柳州新能源汽车产销量均首次突破百万大关，零部件本地配套率达68%；柳工集团海外营收占比超50%。战略性新兴产业产值占工业比重达33.6%，累计建成新能源电池电芯产能57.5GWh。柳江航道升级为Ⅱ级航道，2000吨级船舶可通江达海；“柳州—钦州—东盟”铁海联运专列成功开行。获批设立中国（柳州）跨境电商综合试验区，2025年工业出口交货值达319.7亿元。从内陆腹地到开放前沿，柳州正把向海图强势能转化为开放发展实绩。
text_en: According to a press conference on Liuzhou's efforts to do a good job in the "123" strategy of becoming a strong maritime power and promoting open development, and to promote high-quality development, Liuzhou's new energy vehicle production and sales both exceeded the one-million mark for the first time in 2025, with the local supporting rate for parts reaching 68%; LiuGong Group's overseas revenue accounted for more than 50%. The output value of strategic emerging industries accounted for 33.6% of industry, and cumulative new energy battery cell production capacity reached 57.5GWh. The Liujiang waterway was upgraded to a Class II waterway, allowing 2,000-ton vessels to reach the sea via inland waterways; the "Liuzhou-Qinzhou-ASEAN" rail-sea intermodal train was successfully launched. Approval was granted to establish the China (Liuzhou) Cross-Border E-Commerce Comprehensive Pilot Zone, and the 2025 industrial export delivery value reached 31.97 billion yuan. From an inland hinterland to a frontier of openness, Liuzhou is translating its momentum toward becoming a strong maritime power into tangible results in open development.
